verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs clearly show API-driven 3DS enrollment options (OTP, out-of-band, passkey) for cardholders, satisfying that half of the story, and general card lifecycle management (activate/suspend/close, balance updates) is API-based. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of PIN set/reset flows via API, so that core requirement is unverified. missing for 10: PIN set/reset API documentation, evidence of no-ticket PIN management workflow.
